During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agent [[Tay Vanis]] attempted to '''infiltrate''' [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor (Moff)|Bandor's]] [[Bandor's Palace|palace]] on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]] to rescue his brother-in-law [[Rogan]]. However, Vanis was also captured and had to be rescued by a group of Rebel operatives.<ref name="TGCoQ" />
